decision_autonomy.scope: Authorized reversible work in the current session; no merge, production, credential, or scientific approval grant.
decision_autonomy.authorization: Reuse explicit user authorization within its action, resource and risk scope. Ask only for missing authority or an irreducible material choice, after preparing the concrete result. Never manufacture exact-digest approval.
decision_autonomy.external_gates: Scientific approval ledgers, runtime tool consent, required CI and branch protection remain authoritative.

task_completion.completion: The main session owns scope, implementation, checks and final handoff. Finish when acceptance is met. New findings expand scope only when needed for acceptance or causally required for safety; otherwise record follow-up.
task_completion.coordination: Use one session by default. Load domain context as needed. Use one fresh read-only reviewer for triggered risks, consolidating questions. Use native planning and lifecycle tools; no routing agents, loop coordinators, invocation ledgers or per-task trial enrollment.
task_completion.authorization: Reuse explicit user authorization within its action, resource and risk scope. Ask only for missing authority or an irreducible material choice, after preparing the concrete result. Never manufacture exact-digest approval.
task_completion.verification: Run the smallest sufficient checks, plus required CI. Reuse evidence only for unchanged relevant inputs. Review new material deltas; do not repeat unaffected reviews. A missing mandatory check blocks its dependent action, not unrelated authorized work.
task_completion.waits: Name the running job, completion signal and next action. Reuse an active thread, use native completion, do not duplicate or poll needlessly. Confirm termination before replacement.

bot_dependency_ci_path.provenance: Verify provider PR identity and complete change history, not labels or claimed authorship. Only an unchanged native Dependabot dependency update, optionally with a reviewed mechanical refresh against current main, qualifies. Unknown, incomplete, or malformed provenance takes the normal final-preflight path.
bot_dependency_ci_path.allowed_delta: Only native dependency manifests and their matching lockfiles may carry dependency version changes and corresponding native bot lockfile delta; workflow changes are limited to native bot action uses version/reference bumps. Listed paths are examples, not evidence of eligibility. Review the base refresh to establish that it preserves this delta without manual conflict resolution.
bot_dependency_ci_path.exclusions: Any agent-authored code, workflow, generated-file change, dependency delta, or conflict repair requires the existing final preflight. Package scripts, workflow behavior/permissions, and paths outside dependency manifests, matching lockfiles, or workflow action references are outside this path.
bot_dependency_ci_path.evidence: Record current head and base, provenance, reviewed delta, current required CI, specialist conclusions, and independent Quality. Never claim a local preflight ran when it did not. This guidance cannot waive an effective GitHub gate or authorize merge.
